pages.title: Personal how-to and interface settings
requirements: Actual body scroll reaches the final section with fixed reachable actions.
Back returns control to the battlefield without changing the game engine viewport or leaving held input.

before.title: HOW TO PLAY
before.text:
DEFEND & SURVIVE

Protect your Command Centre; losing it ends the battle. You have 3 minutes to prepare before Wave 1 starts automatically. Survive 30 rounds and clear the final enemies to win.

Waves follow their own timer, even while enemies remain. During a countdown, SKIP WAVE calls the next wave early; it does not clear enemies. Destroying enemies earns power.

BUILD WITH YOUR TRUCKS

BUILD selects construction trucks visible in your view. Choose a structure, then tap valid locations to queue sites. Green blueprints mark accepted orders. Your manually selected truck group is kept when choosing structures.

For another area, move the view and use TRUCKS to select its visible trucks. EXIT · KEEP ORDERS or SELECT / MOVE leaves placement while trucks continue. STOP cancels selected trucks’ work and remaining sites.

UPGRADE WITH MODULES

In BUILD → MODULES, choose an upgrade and tap a highlighted, completed matching building: Research Module → research lab; Power Module → power generator; Factory Module → vehicle or VTOL factory.

Labs and power generators each take one module; vehicle and VTOL factories take two. Highlights show ready, upgrading or full buildings. Finish the matching structure or research the module first if none is ready.

CHOOSE YOUR RESEARCH

Top TECH opens the full page. Choose a lab, browse available topics, then tap ADD TO LAB … QUEUE. You choose every topic; each lab follows its own order. Use × to remove a waiting topic and BACK TO BATTLE to apply your queues.

Tap one of your completed labs on the battlefield to open that lab’s full research page.

CHECK CURRENT ACTIVITY

Bottom-left RESEARCH and PRODUCTION open narrow status panels while you watch the battlefield. Research shows each lab’s current topic and estimated progress; Production shows current units, with vehicle and cyborg tabs.

These panels show current work only. Use top TECH or PRODUCTION to change queues. Tap the selected footer button again or × to close the panel.

MAKE UNITS IN A FACTORY

Open top PRODUCTION, or tap one of your completed factories on the battlefield. Select the intended factory, choose QUANTITY (1, 5, 10 or 20), then PRODUCE a compatible design. Orders belong to the selected factory. Use UNITS, DESIGN and BLUEPRINTS inside Production to switch tasks.

Production uses normal power and build time. Research, factory type, modules and unit limits still apply. The full page shows current work and waiting units; QUEUE shows wider activity.

KEEP YOUR BLUEPRINTS

In PRODUCTION → DESIGN, choose a researched body, propulsion and weapon or system; name it and SAVE BLUEPRINT. Edit with SAVE CHANGES, or keep another version with SAVE AS NEW.

Protect your Command Centre; losing it ends the battle. You have 3 minutes to prepare before Wave 1 starts automatically. Survive 30 rounds and clear the final enemies to win.

Waves follow their own timer, even while enemies remain. During a countdown, SKIP WAVE calls the next wave early; it does not clear enemies. Destroying enemies earns power.

BUILD WITH YOUR TRUCKS

BUILD selects construction trucks visible in your view. Choose a structure, then tap valid locations to queue sites. Green blueprints mark accepted orders. Your manually selected truck group is kept when choosing structures.

For another area, move the view and use TRUCKS to select its visible trucks. EXIT · KEEP ORDERS or SELECT / MOVE leaves placement while trucks continue. STOP cancels selected trucks’ work and remaining sites.

UPGRADE WITH MODULES

In BUILD → MODULES, choose an upgrade and tap a highlighted, completed matching building: Research Module → research lab; Power Module → power generator; Factory Module → vehicle or VTOL factory.

Labs and power generators each take one module; vehicle and VTOL factories take two. Highlights show ready, upgrading or full buildings. Finish the matching structure or research the module first if none is ready.

CHOOSE YOUR RESEARCH

Top TECH opens the full page. Choose a lab, browse available topics, then tap ADD TO LAB … QUEUE. You choose every topic; each lab follows its own order. Use × to remove a waiting topic and BACK TO BATTLE to apply your queues.

Tap one of your completed labs on the battlefield to open that lab’s full research page.

CHECK CURRENT ACTIVITY

Bottom-left RESEARCH and PRODUCTION open narrow status panels while you watch the battlefield. Research shows each lab’s current topic and estimated progress; Production shows current units, with vehicle and cyborg tabs.

These panels show current work only. Use top TECH or PRODUCTION to change queues. Tap the selected footer button again or × to close the panel.

MAKE UNITS IN A FACTORY

Open top PRODUCTION, or tap one of your completed factories on the battlefield. Select the intended factory, choose QUANTITY (1, 5, 10 or 20), then PRODUCE a compatible design. Orders belong to the selected factory. Use UNITS, DESIGN and BLUEPRINTS inside Production to switch tasks.

Production uses normal power and build time. Research, factory type, modules and unit limits still apply. The full page shows current work and waiting units; QUEUE shows wider activity.
